A very warm welcome to The Academy of Cuxton School's website! We hope that you will enjoy visiting our website and that it will provide you with a good insight into our vibrant, happy and successful school. The staff at our school are caring, experienced and committed to meeting the individual needs of every child, and creating a happy, secure environment for pupils ages 2-11. 'The Academy of Cuxton Schools' is part of The Primary First Trust Limited, a Company Limited by Guarantee registered in England and Wales number 08738750 and an Exempt Charity. Our Trust
Welcome to Primary First, a Trust that truly celebrates and nurtures the diversity and distinctiveness of its partner schools. Parents & Community
Adverse Weather Conditions/School Closure Information
Snow and Ice
In the event of severe weather conditions we have to consider key issues to make judgements about school closure. Closing the school is the very last option for us. We know that for working parents when the school has to close this presents problems with regard to childcare, so the decision will not be taken lightly.
We have to weigh up many different risks regarding travelling to school, site safety and pupil supervision on site. Maintaining the level of learning is extremely important, but we have to balance that against the risks to our pupils and staff.
We will monitor local weather reports and liaise with our staff members in outlying areas to assess the travel conditions that might be affecting those who come to school by car and bus.
We will assess if we have sufficient numbers of staff on site to allow us to effectively supervise over 400 pupils.
To keep you informed:

Meet the Governance Partners
Welcome to the Governance Partner's Section
At The Academy of Cuxton Schools we have a committed and dedicated Governance Partnership Body. All Governance Partners work to ensure the effective management of the school, alongside the Head and her Deputy, and contribute a range of skills from a variety of backgrounds. The relationship between the Governance Partners and the Head Teacher and staff is one of support and challenge.
Governance Partners are volunteers who serve a period of four years. Our Governance Partners are often in school, formally and informally, keeping in touch with school life. Our Governance Partners meet regularly throughout the year, either as a 'whole body' or in sub committees.
Governance Partners have some input on the following:
If you are interested in becoming a Governance Partner, or knowing more about the role, please contact the school office.
Mrs Natalie Jackson – Governance Partner Chair - Parent Governance Partner, Safeguarding Governance Partner
I live in Cuxton and have two children, who attended the Academy of Cuxton Schools from reception, and have now moved on to secondary school.
I joined the school community in 2016 and have always been very involved, initially serving on the Parent Teacher Association for 3 years and then assisting in Forest School sessions for a further year. I became part of the Governance body in 2020.
My background is in Management, HR and local governance, and I am fortunate enough to be able to visit school regularly, supporting the team in any way that I can - whether that is practical help, monitoring or constructive challenge. I have now been involved for long enough to have seen many projects from inception to impact and can attest to the incredible journey of the school over recent years.
Along with the other members of the Governance body, I am proud to be a part of this team and look forward to continuing to support the school.
Miss Charlotte Hodder – Staff Elected Governance Partner
My name is Charlotte Hodder, I am currently a Year 3 teacher, though I have worked across KS1, LKS2 and UKS2. I am also the Maths lead at The Academy of Cuxton Schools. I also lead work groups developing other Maths Leads from around the county through the Maths Hub. I have worked in schools for the last 11 years, at Cuxton for almost 9. For the majority of my time at Cuxton, I have undertaken the role as a Staff Elected Governance Partner. Before entering the teaching profession, I studied a BSc honours degree in Social Work from the University of Portsmouth, this came from experiences where my parents became foster parents when I was a child. I then went on to gain my teaching qualification from Canterbury Christchurch. I am passionate about working with children from all backgrounds and believe that all children deserve the best quality of education. Having seen the benefits that having positive school experiences and role-models can have on young people, I hope that I am able to support the school in providing our children with the best experiences possible.
Miss Isabelle Evans - Staff Elected Governance Partner
My name is Isabelle Evans and I am currently a class teacher at The Academy of Cuxton Schools. I completed my BA Primary Education degree at University of Greenwich in 2021. After this, I was a Year 4 Teacher and Design & Technology Lead for 3 years at my previous school. Due to purchasing my own property in Rochester, it was time for me to move schools to somewhere more local, Cuxton! I have been a Year 6 Teacher and PE Lead for 2 years now and I have enjoyed every second. I am an adventurous person and forever pushing myself to achieve my next challenge. From September, I will be the Key Stage 2 Phase Lead and I look forward to taking on further responsibility at Cuxton Primary and supporting the children's progression further. As a Governance Partner, I hope to work alongside the school in helping every child thrive and enjoy a rewarding and positive school journey.
Mr Alex Brett - PFT Appointed Governance Partner
My name is Alex Brett and I was previously the Upper Key Stage 2 Phase Lead and English Lead at the Academy of Cuxton Schools. I have worked in schools for over 10 years and have been a Governance Partner throughout most of my teaching career. Before entering the teaching profession, I achieved a BSc honours degree in Sport and Exercise Science from the University of Greenwich and also worked as a gymnastics and free running coach. As a child, my parents were foster carers; I grew up supporting children from a variety of backgrounds and have seen first-hand the effects a positive school experience can have. As a result, I am passionate about working with, and supporting, children to be the best that they can be. I hope that in my role as a Governance Partner, I will be able to support the school in giving each child the best school experience possible.
Miss Catherine Fearn - Parent Appointed Governance Partner, SEN Governance Partner
I have had children attending The Academy of Cuxton Schools since 2012, during this time I have seen the school grow, develop, and go from strength and strength.
I work for a large multi-academy trust in the south east of England and have an in-depth knowledge and experience of the education sector, both primary and secondary phases, particularly within the fields of governance, safeguarding, curriculum, and school finance.
I am delighted to have the opportunity to be able to support the school as a Parent Governance Partner. I am passionate about enabling all children, and in particular those with special educational needs, to have every opportunity possible to achieve their very best, in a positive and supportive school community.
Mrs Samantha Fielon - Parent Appointed Governance Partner
My name is Samantha Fielon and I currently have a daughter who attends The Academy of Cuxton Schools.
I have been actively involved with the school since my eldest daughter started in 2018
In my experience the school is an incredible place for our little ones to thrive and develop, I strongly believe that children should have a good day to day experience at school where they can achieve their full academic potential. This comes from the fantastic leadership team and the amazing staff who work at the school.
My professional and personal experience has provided me with an in-depth knowledge and understanding of what is required from the school, parents/carers to achieve the childrens full academic potential.
I actively volunteer and have done for a number of years at the school of which I really enjoy, specially making a difference with the children.
In my day job I am a senior underwriter within the real estate division and have extensive experience with data analysis, managing teams and working with others to drive service and delivery along with negotiation and technical skills in order to do my job, which can be transferred into the school governance partner role.
I am thrilled to have been elected and cannot wait to contribute and be a part of something special. As stated in my personal statement the children are at the heart of everything I do!
Mr Matt Piggott - PFT Appointed Governance Partner
I am originally from Essex but have lived in Kent and worked in Kent schools over the past decade. I completed my teaching qualification through Kent & Medway training as a science teacher with Chemistry specialism, finishing in 2014. Prior to this I attended Canterbury Christchurch University where I studied Sport & Exercise Science. I am currently the Vice Principal at Strood Academy and have been there since June 5th 2023, and I am privileged to serve our local community and our incredible pupils. I am excited by the opportunity to join as a Governance Partner for The Academy of Cuxton Schools, I have been highly impressed with the atmosphere and culture I have observed in my visit and am keen to provide my support in any way I can moving forwards.
If any parents of Academy of Cuxton School pupils have any questions or queries regarding Strood Academy or my role as a governor I would be happy to be contacted and can provide a tour of our Academy.
Miss Nicole King- PFT Appointed Governance Partner
My name is Nicole King. I am a Trust Appointed Governance partner who was appointed in 2024.
I am an experienced education professional with over 12 years of teaching experience as a qualified English teacher. Throughout my career, I have worked in several local secondary schools, which has lead to a strong understanding of curriculum development, student progress, safeguarding, and the challenges facing schools and young people today. Now I run a local tuition business and support students from all year groups and a variety of schools. I am proud to be a governance partner at Cuxton and of the community and achievement of the school. I look forward to supporting the school further to ensure that every student has the opportunity to thrive both academically and personally.
Mrs Clare Budden - PFT Appointed Governance Partner
I’ve lived in Cuxton for over 10 years and my eldest daughter is in year 6 at the Academy of Cuxton Schools. My youngest daughter has just started at the nursery.
I am really looking forward to playing more of a part in the school community, where my eldest daughter is so happy and supported by the staff.
I have a strong interest in education, coming from generations of teachers and education professionals. I nearly went in to teaching myself, being offered a place on an undergraduate teaching degree at Canterbury Christ Church, but decided on another degree and career path. I’m really interested in supporting high quality teaching and a positive, inclusive environment for all pupils, having worked in Human Resources in higher education for nearly 20 years.
I’ll be bringing my experience in management, organisation development, learning and development and equality, diversity and inclusion to support the school’s continued development and ensuring all children have a sense of belonging in school irrespective of culture or need.
If you wish to contact the Chair of the Governance Partnership Board, please address your letter to:
Mrs. Natalie Jackson (Chair of Governance Partnership Board) c/o Governor Lead The Primary First Trust The White House Clifton Marine Parade Gravesend
